integrity: General occupancy/missing-mass covariance components and moments are treated as prior theory; only the sharp five-category sign threshold is presented as a new claim. No fabricated authorship or independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two iid observations and finite categorical laws; establishes minimal support for possible positive covariance, not the complete positive-sign region, maxima or larger-sample behavior. Historical priority remains subject to independent verification.
title: Five categories are the sharp threshold for positive richness–missing-mass covariance after two draws
